headline: As of 2026-09-24: 218,993 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 17 of 50 states, D+48.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 218,993 early/mail ballots cast so far across 17 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+48.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (117,602), New Jersey (46,692), Wisconsin (21,149).
